algorithms.title: 60-Second Incident Classification
algorithms.description: Run this in your head while you're still in the cab.
steps: Count & severity: do casualties exceed what is immediately available? → If yes, DECLARE MCI.
Open or closed? Are victims finite/known, or still appearing/unknown?
Simple or compound? Are roads, hospitals, comms, utilities intact?
Hazard type: natural vs human-made; CBRNE? structural? violence/secondary device?
Predict the injury pattern from the disaster type (crush, burns, drowning, blast, asphyxia).
Translate into resource requests in your METHANE report (Chapter 2).
